Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left-turn lane at an intersection in League City, Texas, when the collision
occurred. While completing a left turn, Driver 1's vehicle was struck by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through
the intersection. Driver 1 identified themselves as the registered owner and the driver named on the policy covering
the vehicle. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat, and both the Passenger and the officer confirmed
the Passenger's presence in the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and was
evaluated at the scene. The injury description is consistent with the type and force of the impact observed. Driver 2
stated that the clolision happened as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses gave accounts that match.
Scene photographs also show damage consistent with the reported sequence. No prior damage to the vehicle was
known to Driver 1 or noted on inspection. It is not clear from the scene whether all of the visible damage resulted from
this single impact, and this has been noted for further review.
